data.desc: NFT Limited (formerly known as Takung Art Co Ltd.) operates an online electronic platform ( www.nftoeo.com ) for offering and trading of digital artwork. Through its subsidiary Metaverse HK, the Company allows artists, art dealers, and owners to access a broader art trading market. The Company also provides NFT consulting services. Through its subsidiary Agent Link Tech Ltd., the Company is upgrading its platform with the RWAIX protocol.
